description: Send a quote request, or an appointment request with up to 3 preferred times, to one business on behalf of the customer. The business receives it by e-mail and a person there accepts, proposes another time or declines. The result is pending, never booked. Checks the answers to the intake_questions of the service: if something is missing, nothing is sent and problems lists what to ask the customer. Requires the consent of the customer. Safe to repeat with the same idempotency_key. Only if the customer said the job is urgent: with urgent: true the request may go to up to 5 businesses at once (business_ids, service_ids). Name these businesses to the customer first and get their consent for all of them. The first business that accepts gets the job, the others are told that it is taken. Businesses can only accept or decline an urgent request, and it expires after 30 minutes if nobody accepts. An entry from unverified (lst_…) with can_forward: true can be passed as business_id without service_id: that business is not on Bookvia, the customer first has to click a button in an e-mail from Bookvia, and only then does the request go to the business. Whether it answers is open.

answers.description: Answers to the intake_questions of the service from get_business_profile

question_id.description: id of an entry in intake_questions of the service

business_id.description: ID from search_businesses. The usual case: one request goes to one business. Pass either business_id or business_ids, never both. May also be the id of an entry from unverified (lst_…) with can_forward: true. That business is not on Bookvia: leave service_id, answers and preferred_times out, and nothing goes to it before the customer clicked the button in an e-mail from Bookvia.

business_ids.description: Only together with urgent: true. 1 to 5 different business IDs from search_businesses. Before you call: tell the customer the names of these businesses and that the first one that accepts gets the job, and get their consent to send the request to all of them. Never add a business the customer has not heard of.

email.description: Real e-mail address of the customer. The answer of the business is sent there. Never invent one.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the customer wants to be called

customer_consent.description: true only if the customer explicitly agreed that this request with their name and contact details is sent to this business, or to every business in business_ids. Ask before you call this tool.

description.description: The job in the words of the customer, in German

idempotency_key.description: Random key you create once per customer request, e.g. a UUID. Send the SAME key again when you retry or correct this request, so the business never gets it twice. Must not contain personal data.

preferred_times.description: Up to 3 times the customer would like. Only for services with action = appointment at businesses that accept appointments. Turns the request into an appointment request.

end.description: ISO 8601. If omitted, the usual duration of the service is used

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

service_id.description: ID of the service from get_business_profile. Needed with business_id, except for an unverified listing (lst_…), which has no services.

service_ids.description: With business_ids: for every business exactly one of its services, IDs from get_business_profile, in any order.

urgent.description: true only if the customer said the job is urgent. Ask the customer; never conclude it from the kind of job. An urgent request may go to up to 5 businesses at once (business_ids): the first business that accepts gets the job, the others are told at once that it is taken. It expires after a short time (see expires_at) if nobody accepts. A business can only accept or decline it, so preferred_times is not allowed: put the timing wish into description.

name: request_quote

duplicate.description: true = this request already existed (same idempotency_key or same content). It was not sent a second time.

group.description: Only for urgent requests (urgent: true): the common state of the job and the state at every business

accepted_by.description: The business that accepted first and has the job. null as long as nobody accepted.

expires_at.description: While pending: if no business accepts by then, the urgent request expires and the customer is told by e-mail

group_id.description: Same for all requests of one urgent job

notice.description: What the common state means and what you may tell the customer

requests.description: One entry per business the customer agreed to, in the order of business_ids

not_sent_reason.description: Why nothing was sent to this business, e.g. business_request_limit_reached. Otherwise null

request_id.description: Use with get_request_status. null if nothing was sent to this business

status.description: State at this business. cancelled with taken_by_other = true: another business accepted first

submitted.description: false: nothing was sent to this business, see not_sent_reason. The other businesses still got the request.

taken_by_other.description: true: this request was closed because another business accepted first. The business was told that the job is taken.

status.description: Common state of the urgent job: pending = at least one business can still accept, nothing is agreed yet. confirmed = one business accepted first and has the job. declined = every business said no. expired = nobody accepted in time. cancelled = the customer withdrew.

business_id.description: Only for a request to several businesses: the business this problem refers to. Left out if it concerns all of them

code.description: Machine-readable reason. Known values: missing_answer, invalid_answer, unknown_question, invalid_customer, invalid_description, consent_required, quote_not_accepted, appointment_not_accepted, invalid_preferred_time, urgent_no_preferred_times. More may be added later; for an unknown code, rely on message.

field.description: Input field the problem refers to, e.g. answers or customer.email

options.description: Allowed answers for type choice, otherwise empty

question.description: The question in German. Ask the customer this before sending a request.

required.description: true = request_quote is rejected without an answer

type.description: text = free text, choice = exactly one of options, yes_no = true or false, number = a number

question.description: The question to ask the customer, if an answer is missing or invalid

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

appointment.description: Agreed time. Only set when status is confirmed and a time was agreed.

expires_at.description: While pending: deadline for the answer. For an unverified listing with waiting_for = customer: deadline for the click of the customer. After that the status becomes expired.

group.description: Only for urgent requests: the common state of the job and the state at every business it went to

accepted_by.description: The business that accepted first and has the job. null as long as nobody accepted.

expires_at.description: While pending: if no business accepts by then, the urgent request expires and the customer is told by e-mail

group_id.description: Same for all requests of one urgent job

notice.description: What the common state means and what you may tell the customer

requests.description: One entry per business the customer agreed to, in the order of business_ids

not_sent_reason.description: Why nothing was sent to this business, e.g. business_request_limit_reached. Otherwise null

request_id.description: Use with get_request_status. null if nothing was sent to this business

status.description: State at this business. cancelled with taken_by_other = true: another business accepted first

submitted.description: false: nothing was sent to this business, see not_sent_reason. The other businesses still got the request.

taken_by_other.description: true: this request was closed because another business accepted first. The business was told that the job is taken.

status.description: Common state of the urgent job: pending = at least one business can still accept, nothing is agreed yet. confirmed = one business accepted first and has the job. declined = every business said no. expired = nobody accepted in time. cancelled = the customer withdrew.

message_from_business.description: Message of the business for the customer, in German

notice.description: What this state means and what you may tell the customer

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

proposal.description: The business proposed this time instead. NOT confirmed. The customer accepts or declines via the link in their e-mail. Only set while pending.

status.description: pending = waiting, nothing is agreed yet. confirmed = a person at the business said yes. declined = the business said no. expired = nobody answered in time. cancelled = the customer withdrew, or for an urgent request another business accepted first (see group), or Bookvia could not pass a request on to an unverified listing (see notice). Only confirmed means the business agreed.

unverified.description: true: the request is for a business that is NOT on Bookvia (an entry from unverified). business.id is then the listing id (lst_…), and it is open whether the business answers. Only present for such requests

urgent.description: true: an urgent request. Only present for urgent requests

waiting_for.description: Only for a request to an unverified listing while pending. customer = nothing was sent to the business yet: the customer first has to click the button in the e-mail from Bookvia. business = the customer clicked, the request was passed on, and it is open whether the business answers

request.description: The request. For an urgent request to several businesses: the request of the business that accepted first, otherwise of the first business it was sent to. All businesses are in group.

submitted.description: true = the request is stored and on its way to the business. For an unverified listing (lst_…): stored, but it only goes to the business after the customer clicked the button in the e-mail from Bookvia (see request.waiting_for). false = NOTHING was sent: solve the problems and call request_quote again with the same idempotency_key.

title: Send a request to a business
